title: Systems Engineer- II
description:
**Responsibilities (List All)**
* Lead projects to achieve cost, quality and schedule targets.
* Build system\-level prototypes and plan engineering builds to evaluate and validate product designs.
* Coordinate cross\-functional feedback from engineering builds and drive issue resolution.
* Develop product\-level technical specifications, DFMEAs and test plans based on customer needs, field data and reliability requirements.
* Integrate and package mechanical, electronic and hydraulic systems, considering their interactions and dependencies.
* Communicate order configurators and colour schemes to subsystem owners to initiate bills of material.
* Clarify configurator and product\-feature queries with Customer Service and Product Management.
* Verify system\-level bills of material before release and support production\-order line issues.
* Coordinate updates and releases of service, installation and owner manuals, end\-of\-line test specifications and other technical documents.
* Track field and internal issues, maintain resolution plans, and perform engineering change\-management activities using Windchill and SAP.


****Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack** 
***(List all)*****
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electronics, with 5\-7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience launching new products while working with manufacturing teams and suppliers.
* Experience in engineering project execution, cross\-functional coordination and a stage\-gate, tollgate or milestone development process.
* Working knowledge of GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, DFMEA, FEA, tolerance analysis and statistical tools.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, with sound knowledge of engineering principles, theory and practice.


**Preferable**
* Experience integrating or designing complex electro\-mechanical systems.
* Knowledge of sheet\-metal components, stamping and bending processes, plastic injection moulds, castings and different material types.
* Working knowledge of Windchill and SAP; experience in the dispenser, home\-appliance, automotive or peripherals industry is preferred.


**Who Is Gilbarco Veeder\-root**
 Gilbarco Veeder\-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. For over 150 years, Gilbarco has earned the trust of its customers by providing long\-term partnership, uncompromising support, and proven reliability. Major product lines include fuel dispensers, tank gauges and fleet management systems.
